runs.text: The kiosk sells biscuits at 2 pesos. Read the value of the note and the number of biscuits, in that order, and show the change. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Use the card from the previous exercise and add two worked examples.
Two values go in: two boxes and two reads, as in
The change is what was paid minus what the biscuits cost.

runs.text: The price goes up to 3 pesos. How many lines did you have to change? If it was more than one, keep the price in a box with a name.
Frequent mistake: reading in the opposite order to the statement. The cases with 0 change check that nothing extra was subtracted.
